description: Source code implementing LSP averaging and reset functions for AMR speech codec, including functions lsp_avg_reset and lsp_avg, with related includes and macros.

methods.name: lsp_avg_reset
methods.description: Resets the lsp_avgState structure by copying mean_lsf_5 into lsp_meanSave.

methods.name: lsp_avg
methods.description: Updates the lsp_meanSave with a weighted average of previous mean and current LSPs, handling overflow via pOverflow flag.
